correctness.rationale: Marking one occurrence of every linear-one-run window leaves an integral flow from N_i = 1^i0^(k-1-i) to P_j = 0^(k-1-j)1^j in the full de Bruijn digraph. Each path must shift away i leading ones before it can reach any P_j. At equality there are no surplus cycles and the arrival after i steps forces j <= i. Bijectivity forces j=i, hence the appended symbols are forced to be 1^i. This proves both the unrestricted lower bound and the forced exact circular-one-run spectrum. The mandatory subgraph is strongly connected via 0^(k-1); adding the paths balances it and attaches every new vertex. For the enumeration, the BEST formula applies with the unique 0^k loop fixed first. In an in-tree toward 0^(k-1), the largest N_i that would select its path to P_i would return to itself, via some N_j with j>=i whose larger indices all descend, so all N_i must descend. The k-2 P_i each have two independent choices. The empty-flow and empty-choice cases at k=2 yield one class. An independently constructed out-Laplacian cofactor, taking windows with at most two circular changes, gave determinants 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256 for k=2..10; this is finite corroboration, not the all-k proof.
residual_risks: The frozen verifier uses int.bit_count() despite the Python 3.9+ claim in VERIFICATION.md; use Python 3.10+ for that verifier. This does not affect the theorem or the independent determinant check.

evidence: That record's W_n has at most two internal changes; on closing the word into a circle an odd count of internal changes gains one and an even count gains zero. Thus W_n is exactly C_n. Its cycles use each word once, identify only rotations, and count 2^(n-2).
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The prescribed-spectrum subproblem and its exact count are equivalent. Covering only R_k and allowing arbitrary extra windows is a different feasible set; the reviewed theorem proves why those two sets of extremizers nevertheless agree.

value.rationale: This is a natural family for cyclic coverage. Proving a sharp overhead against all binary hosts, even those allowed to use arbitrary extra windows, and identifying every extra window at equality is substantially more informative than constructing one universal cycle. It also tells a user precisely when the completed-family enumeration counts all optimal hosts.
residual_risks: No claim for multiple runs, linear superstrings or identification under reversals.
